title: Beef Bourguignon
description: Julia Child's legendary French braised beef stew cooked low and slow in red wine with pearl onions, mushrooms, and lardons.
ingredients: 1.5kg beef chuck, cut into large cubes
instructions: Pat beef dry and season with salt and pepper. Brown in batches in a Dutch oven over high heat. Set aside.
Cook lardons until crispy. Add carrots and garlic, sauté 3 minutes.
Return beef to pot. Sprinkle flour over and toss to coat.
Add wine, stock, tomato paste, and bouquet garni. Bring to boil.
Cover and braise in oven at 160°C (325°F) for 2.5 hours.
Meanwhile, sauté pearl onions and mushrooms in butter until golden.
Add onions and mushrooms to the stew in last 30 minutes.
Remove bouquet garni. Adjust seasoning and serve with crusty bread or mashed potatoes.
author: Chef Pierre
